provider: kts24 — 1 tb storage vps free for 3 months (ceph beta)

free_tier.stated: 1000 GB storage on an unmanaged VPS with 1 vCore, 2 GB memory and 2 TB traffic per month, free of charge for at least 3 months; EUR 8.99 per month after the 3 months. A test offer posted in March 2022 in a discussion that is now closed
free_tier.notes: a March 2022 test offer in a LowEndSpirit thread that is now closed; trial servers expire at the end of the trial unless extended

identity_cost.detail: the March 2022 test needed an account at the provider's panel and a request e-mail sent from the registered address; no card was asked for in the offer text. The offer is closed

evidence.proved: the provider's March 2022 post offers its ceph storage VPS free of charge for at least 3 months
evidence.quote: currently we are testing our new ceph based storage vps series, but until know there are only a hand full active customers, I have therefore decided to give you the opportunity to test the service free of charge for at least 3 months.

evidence.proved: the free test VPS carries 1000 GB of storage
the provider's account states that trial servers expire after the trial unless extended
evidence.quote: After the trial period ends, the servers will automatically expire if you do not wish to extend it.

evidence.proved: the VPS costs EUR 8.99 per month after the 3 free months
evidence.quote: The price after the 3 months is 8,99 € / month.

evidence.proved: the provider discontinued the storage VPS project that carried the 1000 GB free test offer
evidence.quote: Unfortunately, this increases the costs so much that we would no longer be competitive in storage and will therefore discontinue the Storage VPS 2022 project.

evidence.proved: every server created for the beta was blocked by the provider
evidence.quote: All services that were created for the BETA test are blocked from now on.

evidence.proved: the provider states the storage VPS series is dead
evidence.quote: The "Storage" VPS Series wich was planned on our ceph storage is dead

evidence.proved: the provider's current VPS plan list tops out at 240 GB of storage
the test offer needed an account at the provider's panel and a request mail from the registered address
evidence.quote: from the email address registered with us.
